name: Digital Realty / Telepoint Sofia East
notes: Digital Realty announced entry into Bulgaria through the acquisition of Telepoint, including two Sofia data centers. Facility listings identify Sofia East as Telepoint's large carrier-neutral Sofia facility.

name: Digital Realty / Telepoint Sofia Centre
notes: Digital Realty's Telepoint acquisition covered two Sofia data centers; Data Center Platform lists TELEPOINT Sofia Centre at 122 Ovcho Pole Street with 113 networks and nine exchanges connected.

name: Equinix Sofia data centers
notes: Equinix states it operates two network-dense, carrier-neutral data centers in Sofia with about 35,000 sq ft / 3,215 sq m of colocation space.

name: Neterra Sofia Data Center 2 (SDC 2)
notes: Neterra opened SDC 2 next to SDC 1 in Sofia; the operator says the four-level facility has over 1,400 sq m and 2 MW of installed capacity.

name: Neterra Sofia Data Center 1 (SDC 1)
notes: Neterra's Sofia Data Center brand page lists SDC 1 and SDC 2 in Sofia among its Bulgarian data centers; the SDC 2 opening announcement says SDC 2 is located next to the existing SDC 1.

name: A1 Lift data center / Exoscale BG-SOF-1 zone
notes: Exoscale lists its BG-SOF-1 zone as hosted by A1 Bulgaria in the Lift data center at 3 Nedelcho Bonchev Street, Sofia; A1 markets data center housing and IT services.

name: Daticum Sofia Data Centre
notes: Daticum's official data centre page offers cloud, dedicated server, and colocation services from 135 Tsarigradsko Shose Blvd., Sofia; facility listings describe a Sofia colocation data center.

name: Neterra SDC Stolnik / Data Center Park Stolnik
notes: Neterra lists SDC Stolnik among its four SDC facilities. Operator news places Stolnik near the largest substation in Southeast Europe, about 20 minutes from Sofia Airport, and part of Data Center Park Stolnik.

name: Vivacom / Eutelsat OneWeb Stara Zagora ground station mini data centre
notes: United Group says the Stara Zagora ground station consists of 18 antennas and a mini data centre connecting LEO satellites to optical networks and data centres; construction started in late 2022, completed in May 2023, and was commissioned before launch.

name: ESCOM Haskovo data center
notes: Data Center Platform and Inflect list ESCOM Haskovo as an operating colocation/data center facility; ESCOM's site confirms the company address in Haskovo but public facility detail is limited.

name: TSBG Kapitan Andreevo data center
notes: Facility listings place a carrier-neutral colocation/data center at 3 Bialo More Street, Kapitan Andreevo in Haskovo Province, with interconnection to local and international network providers.
